<use x="330.342701" xlink:href="#svg_7a653f36ebc29dbc3880_glyph1-2" y="177.207889"></use>
<use x="333.881534" xlink:href="#svg_7a653f36ebc29dbc3880_glyph1-19" y="177.207889"></use>

</g>
</g>
</svg></p>
</figure>
</div>
</section>
</section>
<section class="level1" id="sur-r">
<h1>Sur R</h1>
<section class="level2" id="lacp-avec-factominer">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="lacp-avec-factominer">L’ACP avec FactoMineR</h2>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb1"><pre class="sourceCode r code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb1-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb1-1" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">library</span>(FactoMineR) ; <span class="fu">library</span>(factoextra)</span>
<span id="cb1-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb1-2" tabindex="-1"></a>cl <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">read.csv</span>(<span class="st">"clients.csv"</span>, <span class="at">stringsAsFactors =</span> <span class="cn">TRUE</span>)</span>
<span id="cb1-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb1-3" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb1-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb1-4" tabindex="-1"></a>acp <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">PCA</span>(cl, <span class="at">quanti.sup =</span> <span class="fu">c</span>(<span class="dv">3</span>, <span class="dv">8</span>), <span class="at">quali.sup =</span> <span class="fu">c</span>(<span class="dv">2</span>, <span class="dv">4</span>, <span class="dv">5</span>, <span class="dv">6</span>, <span class="dv">17</span>),</span>
<span id="cb1-5"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb1-5" tabindex="-1"></a>           <span class="at">scale.unit =</span> <span class="cn">TRUE</span>, <span class="at">ncp =</span> <span class="dv">5</span>, <span class="at">graph =</span> <span class="cn">FALSE</span>)</span>
<span id="cb1-6"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb1-6" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb1-7"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb1-7" tabindex="-1"></a>acp<span class="sc">$</span>eig                      <span class="co"># 4.535 (56.69 %) puis 1.645 (20.57 %)</span></span>
<span id="cb1-8"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb1-8" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">fviz_screeplot</span>(acp)          <span class="co"># l'eboulis du chapitre 6</span></span>
<span id="cb1-9"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb1-9" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">fviz_pca_var</span>(acp)            <span class="co"># le cercle des correlations</span></span>
<span id="cb1-10"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb1-10" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">fviz_pca_ind</span>(acp, <span class="at">habillage =</span> <span class="st">"frequence"</span>)</span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
<div class="intuitionbox" title="Les deux arguments qui font tout">
<div class="pedago-title">
Les deux arguments qui font tout
</div>
<p><code>quanti.sup</code> et <code>quali.sup</code> désignent les colonnes <strong>illustratives</strong>. Tout ce qui n’y figure pas est actif.</p>
<p><strong>C’est la décision du chapitre 1, réduite à deux vecteurs d’indices</strong> — et c’est la ligne qu’il faut relire trois fois avant de commenter quoi que ce soit.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="lire-les-aides-à-linterprétation">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="lire-les-aides-à-linterprétation">Lire les aides à l’interprétation</h2>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb2"><pre class="sourceCode r code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb2-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb2-1" tabindex="-1"></a>acp<span class="sc">$</span>var<span class="sc">$</span>cos2[, <span class="dv">1</span><span class="sc">:</span><span class="dv">2</span>]          <span class="co"># qualite de representation des variables</span></span>
<span id="cb2-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb2-2" tabindex="-1"></a>acp<span class="sc">$</span>var<span class="sc">$</span>contrib[, <span class="dv">1</span><span class="sc">:</span><span class="dv">2</span>]       <span class="co"># contribution : accueil 20.5 % sur l'axe 2</span></span>
<span id="cb2-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb2-3" tabindex="-1"></a>acp<span class="sc">$</span>ind<span class="sc">$</span>contrib[, <span class="dv">1</span>]         <span class="co"># aucun individu au-dessus de 1.83 %</span></span>
<span id="cb2-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb2-4" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb2-5"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb2-5" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">dimdesc</span>(acp, <span class="at">axes =</span> <span class="dv">1</span><span class="sc">:</span><span class="dv">2</span>)     <span class="co"># description automatique des axes</span></span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
<div class="definitionbox" title="La fonction la plus utile du paquet">
<div class="pedago-title">
La fonction la plus utile du paquet
</div>
<p><code>dimdesc</code> trie, pour chaque axe, les variables et les modalités les plus liées, avec leur corrélation.</p>
<p><strong>Elle ne remplace pas la lecture du cercle</strong> — elle la vérifie. Un axe qu’on a mal nommé se repère immédiatement dans sa sortie.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="classification-et-discrimination">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="classification-et-discrimination">Classification et discrimination</h2>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb3"><pre class="sourceCode r code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb3-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb3-1" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># CAH sur les axes factoriels, avec consolidation automatique</span></span>
<span id="cb3-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb3-2" tabindex="-1"></a>hc <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">HCPC</span>(acp, <span class="at">nb.clust =</span> <span class="dv">4</span>, <span class="at">consol =</span> <span class="cn">TRUE</span>, <span class="at">graph =</span> <span class="cn">FALSE</span>)</span>
<span id="cb3-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb3-3" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb3-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb3-4" tabindex="-1"></a>hc<span class="sc">$</span>desc.var<span class="sc">$</span>quanti           <span class="co"># ce qui caracterise chaque classe</span></span>
<span id="cb3-5"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb3-5" tabindex="-1"></a>hc<span class="sc">$</span>desc.var<span class="sc">$</span>test.chi2        <span class="co"># les variables qualitatives liees</span></span>
<span id="cb3-6"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb3-6" tabindex="-1"></a>hc<span class="sc">$</span>data.clust<span class="sc">$</span>clust          <span class="co"># la classe de chaque client</span></span>
<span id="cb3-7"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb3-7" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb3-8"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb3-8" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># Analyse discriminante</span></span>
<span id="cb3-9"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb3-9" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">library</span>(MASS)</span>
<span id="cb3-10"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb3-10" tabindex="-1"></a>afd <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">lda</span>(frequence <span class="sc">~</span> prix <span class="sc">+</span> choix <span class="sc">+</span> qualite <span class="sc">+</span> agencement <span class="sc">+</span></span>
<span id="cb3-11"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb3-11" tabindex="-1"></a>             proprete <span class="sc">+</span> rapidite <span class="sc">+</span> conseil <span class="sc">+</span> accueil, <span class="at">data =</span> cl)</span>
<span id="cb3-12"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb3-12" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">table</span>(cl<span class="sc">$</span>frequence, <span class="fu">predict</span>(afd)<span class="sc">$</span>class)          <span class="co"># 67.0 %</span></span>
<span id="cb3-13"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb3-13" tabindex="-1"></a>afdcv <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">lda</span>(frequence <span class="sc">~</span> ., <span class="at">data =</span> cl[, <span class="dv">9</span><span class="sc">:</span><span class="dv">16</span>], <span class="at">CV =</span> <span class="cn">TRUE</span>)  <span class="co"># 65.3 %</span></span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="afc-acm-et-mds">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="afc-acm-et-mds">AFC, ACM et MDS</h2>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb4"><pre class="sourceCode r code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb4-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb4-1" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># AFC sur le tableau croise CSP x motif</span></span>
<span id="cb4-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb4-2" tabindex="-1"></a>tab <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">table</span>(cl<span class="sc">$</span>csp, cl<span class="sc">$</span>motif)</span>
<span id="cb4-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb4-3" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">chisq.test</span>(tab)              <span class="co"># X-squared = 110.41, df = 12</span></span>
<span id="cb4-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb4-4" tabindex="-1"></a>afc <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">CA</span>(tab, <span class="at">graph =</span> <span class="cn">FALSE</span>)</span>
<span id="cb4-5"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb4-5" tabindex="-1"></a>afc<span class="sc">$</span>eig                      <span class="co"># 0.2267 (61.60 %) et 0.1030 (27.98 %)</span></span>
<span id="cb4-6"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb4-6" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb4-7"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb4-7" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># ACM sur les cinq variables qualitatives</span></span>
<span id="cb4-8"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb4-8" tabindex="-1"></a>acm <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">MCA</span>(cl[, <span class="fu">c</span>(<span class="st">"csp"</span>,<span class="st">"frequence"</span>,<span class="st">"carte"</span>,<span class="st">"motif"</span>,<span class="st">"sexe"</span>)], <span class="at">graph =</span> <span class="cn">FALSE</span>)</span>
<span id="cb4-9"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb4-9" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb4-10"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb4-10" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># MDS sur les dissimilarites entre enseignes</span></span>
<span id="cb4-11"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb4-11" tabindex="-1"></a>mds <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">cmdscale</span>(d_enseignes, <span class="at">k =</span> <span class="dv">2</span>, <span class="at">eig =</span> <span class="cn">TRUE</span>)</span>
<span id="cb4-12"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb4-12" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">sum</span>(mds<span class="sc">$</span>eig[<span class="dv">1</span><span class="sc">:</span><span class="dv">2</span>]) <span class="sc">/</span> <span class="fu">sum</span>(mds<span class="sc">$</span>eig[mds<span class="sc">$</span>eig <span class="sc">&gt;</span> <span class="dv">0</span>])    <span class="co"># 97.34 %</span></span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="le-test-et-lanalyse-lun-après-lautre">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="le-test-et-lanalyse-lun-après-lautre">Le test et l’analyse, l’un après l’autre</h2>
<div class="ecobox" title="Une ligne mérite d'être commentée">
<div class="pedago-title">
Une ligne mérite d’être commentée
</div>
<p><code>chisq.test(tab)</code> puis <code>CA(tab)</code> : le test et l’analyse, l’un après l’autre, sur le même objet.</p>
<p><strong>Le premier dit qu’il y a une liaison ; le second dit laquelle.</strong> Les deux lignes ensemble résument tout le chapitre 8.</p>
</div>
</section>
</section>
<section class="level1" id="sur-python">
<h1>Sur Python</h1>
<section class="level2" id="les-équivalents">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="les-équivalents">Les équivalents</h2>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb5"><pre class="sourceCode python code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode python"><span id="cb5-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb5-1" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="im">import</span> pandas <span class="im">as</span> pd, numpy <span class="im">as</span> np, prince</span>
<span id="cb5-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb5-2" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="im">from</span> sklearn.preprocessing <span class="im">import</span> StandardScaler</span>
<span id="cb5-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb5-3" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="im">from</span> sklearn.cluster <span class="im">import</span> KMeans</span>
<span id="cb5-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb5-4" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="im">from</span> sklearn.discriminant_analysis <span class="im">import</span> LinearDiscriminantAnalysis <span class="im">as</span> LDA</span>
<span id="cb5-5"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb5-5" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb5-6"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb5-6" tabindex="-1"></a>cl <span class="op">=</span> pd.read_csv(<span class="st">"clients.csv"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb5-7"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb5-7" tabindex="-1"></a>notes <span class="op">=</span> [<span class="st">"prix"</span>,<span class="st">"choix"</span>,<span class="st">"qualite"</span>,<span class="st">"agencement"</span>,</span>
<span id="cb5-8"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb5-8" tabindex="-1"></a>         <span class="st">"proprete"</span>,<span class="st">"rapidite"</span>,<span class="st">"conseil"</span>,<span class="st">"accueil"</span>]</span>
<span id="cb5-9"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb5-9" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb5-10"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb5-10" tabindex="-1"></a>acp <span class="op">=</span> prince.PCA(n_components<span class="op">=</span><span class="dv">5</span>).fit(cl[notes])</span>
<span id="cb5-11"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb5-11" tabindex="-1"></a>acp.eigenvalues_summary        <span class="co"># 56.69 % puis 20.57 %</span></span>
<span id="cb5-12"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb5-12" tabindex="-1"></a>F <span class="op">=</span> acp.transform(cl[notes])   <span class="co"># les coordonnees des individus</span></span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="classification-et-discrimination-1">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="classification-et-discrimination-1">Classification et discrimination</h2>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb6"><pre class="sourceCode python code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode python"><span id="cb6-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb6-1" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="im">from</span> scipy.cluster.hierarchy <span class="im">import</span> linkage, dendrogram, fcluster</span>
<span id="cb6-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb6-2" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb6-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb6-3" tabindex="-1"></a>Z <span class="op">=</span> linkage(F.iloc[:, :<span class="dv">2</span>], method<span class="op">=</span><span class="st">"ward"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb6-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb6-4" tabindex="-1"></a>dendrogram(Z, no_labels<span class="op">=</span><span class="va">True</span>)</span>
<span id="cb6-5"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb6-5" tabindex="-1"></a>g <span class="op">=</span> fcluster(Z, t<span class="op">=</span><span class="dv">4</span>, criterion<span class="op">=</span><span class="st">"maxclust"</span>)            <span class="co"># 4 classes</span></span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="consolidation-et-discrimination">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="consolidation-et-discrimination">Consolidation et discrimination</h2>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb7"><pre class="sourceCode python code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode python"><span id="cb7-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb7-1" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># k-means partant des centres de la CAH</span></span>
<span id="cb7-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb7-2" tabindex="-1"></a>centres <span class="op">=</span> np.array([F.iloc[:, :<span class="dv">2</span>][g <span class="op">==</span> k].mean() <span class="cf">for</span> k <span class="kw">in</span> <span class="bu">range</span>(<span class="dv">1</span>, <span class="dv">5</span>)])</span>
<span id="cb7-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb7-3" tabindex="-1"></a>km <span class="op">=</span> KMeans(n_clusters<span class="op">=</span><span class="dv">4</span>, init<span class="op">=</span>centres, n_init<span class="op">=</span><span class="dv">1</span>).fit(F.iloc[:, :<span class="dv">2</span>])</span>
<span id="cb7-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb7-4" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb7-5"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb7-5" tabindex="-1"></a>afd <span class="op">=</span> LDA().fit(StandardScaler().fit_transform(cl[notes]), cl.frequence)</span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="la-correspondance-des-commandes">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="la-correspondance-des-commandes">La correspondance des commandes</h2>
<div class="definitionbox" title="R et Python, côte à côte">
<div class="pedago-title">
R et Python, côte à côte
</div>
<table class="caption-top table">
<thead>
<tr class="header">
<th>R</th>
<th>Python</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="odd">
<td><code>PCA</code> (FactoMineR)</td>
<td><code>prince.PCA</code></td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td><code>CA</code></td>
<td><code>prince.CA</code></td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td><code>MCA</code></td>
<td><code>prince.MCA</code></td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td><code>hclust(..., "ward.D2")</code></td>
<td><code>scipy.linkage(..., "ward")</code></td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td><code>kmeans</code></td>
<td><code>sklearn.KMeans</code></td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td><code>lda</code> (MASS)</td>
<td><code>LinearDiscriminantAnalysis</code></td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td><code>cmdscale</code></td>
<td><code>sklearn.manifold.MDS</code></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="lequel-choisir">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="lequel-choisir">Lequel choisir</h2>
<div class="ecobox" title="L'avantage de Python est ailleurs">
<div class="pedago-title">
L’avantage de Python est ailleurs
</div>
<p>Il commence dès que les données sont volumineuses, ou qu’il faut <strong>industrialiser</strong> le calcul du score — le recalculer chaque nuit sur la base clients.</p>
<p>Pour une étude, R. Pour un traitement récurrent, Python.</p>
</div>
<div class="intuitionbox" title="Un avantage réel de R sur ce terrain">
<div class="pedago-title">
Un avantage réel de R sur ce terrain
</div>
<p><code>FactoMineR</code> sort d’emblée contributions, <span class="math inline">\cos^2</span> et éléments illustratifs. En Python, il faut souvent les recalculer.</p>
<p><strong>Ce n’est pas un détail : ce sont exactement les indicateurs sans lesquels un plan factoriel ne s’interprète pas.</strong></p>
</div>
</section>
</section>
<section class="level1" id="les-pièges">
<h1>Les pièges</h1>
<section class="level2" id="ceux-que-le-logiciel-ne-signale-jamais">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="ceux-que-le-logiciel-ne-signale-jamais">Ceux que le logiciel ne signale jamais</h2>
<div class="quarto-figure quarto-figure-center">
<figure class="figure">

<section class="level2" id="ce-que-le-logiciel-ne-fait-pas">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="ce-que-le-logiciel-ne-fait-pas">Ce que le logiciel ne fait pas</h2>
<div class="ecobox" title="Il ne choisit pas les variables actives">
<div class="pedago-title">
Il ne choisit pas les variables actives
</div>
<p><code>PCA(cl)</code> sans argument met <strong>tout</strong> en actif, y compris le panier moyen et l’âge — et sort un résultat parfaitement propre, parfaitement faux.</p>
<p>Aucun message d’erreur ne viendra.</p>
</div>
<div class="ecobox" title="Il ne dit pas si les classes existent">
<div class="pedago-title">
Il ne dit pas si les classes existent
</div>
<p><code>HCPC(acp, nb.clust = 4)</code> produira quatre classes sur trois cents points tirés au hasard, avec un dendrogramme d’apparence convaincante.</p>
<p><strong>C’est au lecteur du saut d’inertie de trancher, pas à la fonction.</strong></p>
</div>
</section>
</section>
<section class="level1" id="ce-quil-faut-retenir">
<h1>Ce qu’il faut retenir</h1>
<section class="level2" id="le-résumé-du-chapitre">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="le-résumé-du-chapitre">Le résumé du chapitre</h2>
<div class="definitionbox" title="Six points">
<div class="pedago-title">
Six points
</div>
<ol type="1">
<li><code>PCA</code>, <code>CA</code>, <code>MCA</code>, <code>HCPC</code>, <code>lda</code>, <code>cmdscale</code> : six fonctions pour les six méthodes.</li>
<li><code>quanti.sup</code> et <code>quali.sup</code> traduisent la décision <strong>active</strong> ou <strong>illustrative</strong>.</li>
<li><code>dimdesc</code> vérifie l’interprétation des axes ; elle ne la remplace pas.</li>
<li><code>HCPC(..., consol = TRUE)</code> enchaîne CAH et <span class="math inline">k</span>-means en une instruction.</li>
<li>R sort les <strong>contributions</strong> et <strong><span class="math inline">\cos^2</span></strong> d’emblée ; Python demande de les recalculer.</li>
<li>Le logiciel <strong>ne choisit pas les variables actives</strong> et <strong>ne dit pas si les classes existent</strong>.</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="intuitionbox" title="La fin du parcours">
<div class="pedago-title">
La fin du parcours
</div>
<p>Cinq méthodes, une seule diagonalisation, un seul fichier de trois cents clients.</p>
<p>Vous avez décrit leurs opinions, croisé leurs profils, formé leurs segments, construit une règle de ciblage et positionné huit enseignes. <strong>Aucun de ces résultats n’était visible dans le tableau de départ</strong> — et c’est précisément l’objet de la discipline.</p>
</div>
</section>
</section>
